---
title: "Test coverage"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Format coverage output as rendered Markdown.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis")
# Locate the package checkout.
coverage_project_directory <- normalizePath("../..", mustWork = TRUE)
# Read the recorded line coverage.
coverage_lines <- read.csv(file.path(coverage_project_directory, "docs/coverage/coverage.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# List the measured source files.
coverage_files <- sort(unique(coverage_lines$filename))
# Count covered source lines.
coverage_covered_count <- sum(coverage_lines$value > 0)
# Count all measured source lines.
coverage_total_count <- nrow(coverage_lines)
# Format the overall coverage percentage.
coverage_percentage <- if (coverage_total_count) sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * coverage_covered_count / coverage_total_count) else "Not measured"
```

```{r overview}
# Display the overall coverage summary.
cat(sprintf("**%s coverage** — %s of %s tracked lines exercised by tests.\n\n", coverage_percentage, coverage_covered_count, coverage_total_count))
```

Select a file to inspect its source. `+` marks covered lines; `!` marks lines not exercised by tests.

[Download line coverage (CSV)](../coverage/coverage.csv) · [Download Cobertura XML](../coverage/coverage.xml)

## Files

```{r files}
# Summarize coverage for each source file.
coverage_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(coverage_files), function(coverage_file_index) {
  # Select coverage counts for the current file.
  coverage_line_counts <- coverage_lines$value[coverage_lines$filename == coverage_files[[coverage_file_index]]]
  # Create the file summary row and its source link.
  data.frame(File = sprintf("[%s](#file-%s)", coverage_files[[coverage_file_index]], coverage_file_index),
    Coverage = sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * mean(coverage_line_counts > 0)),
    Covered = sum(coverage_line_counts > 0), Missed = sum(coverage_line_counts == 0), Total = length(coverage_line_counts),
    check.names = FALSE)
}))
# Render the file coverage table.
if (length(coverage_files)) cat(knitr::kable(coverage_summary, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")), sep = "\n")
```

## Source

```{r source}
# Render annotated source for each measured file.
for (coverage_file_index in seq_along(coverage_files)) {
  # Select the current source filename.
  coverage_file <- coverage_files[[coverage_file_index]]
  # Select its recorded coverage rows.
  coverage_file_rows <- coverage_lines[coverage_lines$filename == coverage_file, , drop = FALSE]
  # Find its uncovered source line numbers.
  coverage_missed_lines <- sort(unique(coverage_file_rows$coverage_line_number[coverage_file_rows$value == 0]))
  # Read the original source text.
  coverage_source_lines <- readLines(file.path(coverage_project_directory, coverage_file), warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  # Add the source file heading and navigation anchor.
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s {#file-%s}\n\n", coverage_file, coverage_file_index))
  # Show links when the file contains uncovered lines.
  if (length(coverage_missed_lines)) {
    # Build links to the uncovered source lines.
    coverage_missed_links <- sprintf("[%s](#file-%s-L%s)", coverage_missed_lines, coverage_file_index, coverage_missed_lines)
    # Render the uncovered-line navigation.
    cat("Uncovered lines: ", paste(coverage_missed_links, collapse = ", "), ".\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    # Report that all measured lines were exercised.
    cat("All tracked lines were exercised.\n\n")
  }
  # Open the collapsible source listing.
  cat('<details class="mb-4"><summary>View source</summary><pre class="mt-2"><code>')
  # Annotate each source line with its coverage status.
  for (coverage_line_number in seq_along(coverage_source_lines)) {
    # Determine whether this line was measured.
    coverage_line_tracked <- coverage_line_number %in% coverage_file_rows$coverage_line_number
    # Determine whether this line was uncovered.
    coverage_line_missed <- coverage_line_number %in% coverage_missed_lines
    # Choose the coverage marker for this line.
    coverage_line_marker <- if (coverage_line_missed) "!" else if (coverage_line_tracked) "+" else " "
    # Choose highlighting for an uncovered line.
    coverage_line_style <- if (coverage_line_missed) ' class="bg-danger bg-opacity-10"' else ""
    # Render the annotated line with its navigation anchor.
    cat(sprintf('<span id="file-%s-L%s"%s>%4s %s %s</span>\n',
      coverage_file_index, coverage_line_number, coverage_line_style, coverage_line_number, coverage_line_marker, htmltools::htmlEscape(coverage_source_lines[[coverage_line_number]])))
  }
  # Close the collapsible source listing.
  cat("</code></pre></details>\n\n")
}
```
